market_pulse.note: About $74,500–$74,600, down roughly 0.4% over 24 hours, after trading between about $73,700 and $75,500; down 2.8% over seven days.
About $2.59 trillion, up roughly 0.7% over 24 hours, on about $75 billion in trading volume.
About 57.8% of total crypto market cap, with Ethereum near 10%.

themes.title: Cautious trading before CPI
themes.summary: Bitcoin hovered near $74,600 as traders waited for Tuesday's October inflation report, with a December Fed rate hike widely priced in.

themes.title: ETF outflows remain in focus
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.28 billion in net outflows in the first week of November, the most since late June.

themes.title: Sentiment edges up but stays fearful
themes.summary: The Fear & Greed Index rose to 32 from 29 a day earlier, still in fear territory.

themes.title: Avalanche gains on NYSE news
themes.summary: AVAX rose roughly 6%–8% over 24 hours after reports that the NYSE selected Avalanche as core settlement ledger technology.

themes.title: Binance scrutiny continues
themes.summary: Media reports describe a probe of about $1.2 billion in flows tied to suspected Iran-linked accounts; Binance denies claims that investigations were obstructed.

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Slightly lower over 24 hours, with ETH (-1.3%) underperforming BTC (-0.4%).

categories.name: Tokenized assets / RWA
categories.note: The strongest category over the past day, helped by tokenization headlines.

categories.name: DeFi & stablecoins
categories.note: DeFi tokens slipped about 0.7% and the stablecoin category was down about 0.1%.

categories.name: Small caps
categories.note: Low-volume tokens swung sharply in both directions, with triple-digit gains and 50%+ losses among the extremes.

watch_list.why: Consensus is +0.3% headline and +0.2% core month over month; the result could shift Fed rate expectations that have weighed on crypto.
Market reports flag about $74,000 as near-term support and $76,000 as a level to reclaim for a sustained rebound.

watch_list.topic: Token unlocks and earnings this week
watch_list.why: ALLO unlocks Nov. 11 (about 88.5% of circulating supply) and AZTEC on Nov. 13; CoreWeave and eToro report Tuesday, with October PPI due Nov. 13.

movers.name: Super Inu (SI)
movers.note: Top 24-hour gainer in a thin, low-volume market.

movers.name: PIEVERSE
movers.note: Rose about 40% on speculation around an AI-agent trading product teaser.

movers.name: Avalanche (AVAX)
movers.note: Up about 8% (other trackers show about 6%) after the NYSE settlement-ledger news.

movers.name: Bitcoin (BTC)
movers.note: Little changed near $74,500 ahead of CPI.
